svg.title: Mnelyra architecture
svg.desc: ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP clients connect through Mnelyra to one active local Workspace. Mnelyra exposes relay, shared context, and workspace tools, with an optional ChatGPT Web model path.

g.text: one relay · one workspace boundary · one shared project context
